decisions.reason: The garage door operator line remains closely tied to the firm's existing garage-door systems, installer network and service know-how, so it is comparatively easy to refine and support commercially.

The solid wood sectional garage door is a more niche offering and less aligned with the firm's metal-focused manufacturing base, but it still leverages its core strengths in garage-door engineering, customization and channel relationships.

The glazed industrial sectional door fits well with the firm's established industrial door expertise, compliance capabilities and business-customer base, which supports ongoing learning and improvement.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door is strongly connected to the firm's knowledge in thermal and regulated building solutions, giving it a strong basis for continued development and commercialization.
